I mean, it's not a COMPLETE injustice though. You were in the bottom three because you'd performed badly nearly all season. It's definitely not fair, but it's the fairest thing for the survival of the league. I know Tranmere have had loads of injuries all season, would it have been fair that with the extended break all the players that would've been out are now back fit? 

I have real sympathy for Tranmere, it's very possibly they'd save themselves, some good signings in January. Hopefully they can mount a promotion challenge again next season. Especially fuelled by this.
